journey: HITL approval review for a proposed project meeting
goal: Identify which existing event conflicts and the exact overlap; inspect without confirming creation.

iterations.biggest_failure: The approval warning disclosed only the number of conflicts.
iterations.root_cause: Conflict details existed in backend display context but were not rendered in the approval card.
iterations.change_selected: Render the existing event title and occupied interval in the account timezone; disclose additional conflicts progressively.
expected_benefits: Understand the occupied time without opening technical details
evidence_after: Blind judge preferred event/time candidate to count-only baseline, confidence 0.98
Static simulator read the event and occupied interval
iterations.remaining_failure: The user still had to calculate the exact intersection between the proposed and occupied intervals.

iterations.biggest_failure: The user still needed to mentally compute which portion of the two time ranges overlapped.
iterations.root_cause: The backend did not expose an explicit overlap interval for this approval display, and the frontend correctly avoided duplicating scheduling semantics.
iterations.change_selected: Compute overlap_start_at/overlap_end_at in backend event and action-proposal services; present the supplied interval in the approval card. Improve card-label and mobile-navigation contrast, make the decision copy neutral, and state that execution waits for confirmation.
expected_benefits: Keep the actual HITL boundary intact
regression_risks: Overlap semantics could be wrong if proposal/event boundaries are mishandled
Missing or malformed overlap fields must remain safe
Mobile fixed navigation can overlay lower viewport content
iterations.next_iteration: Run a browser journey from a real isolated AgentRun into a pending ActionProposal, inspect it on mobile/desktop, and verify apply/Today propagation without auto-approving. Add manual screen-reader and full keyboard walkthrough; retain the fixture-based conflict test as regression coverage.

overall_limit: Current-source mocked Playwright and backend tests cover the presentation and service semantics. No live browser AgentRun approval, apply, or Today/Calendar propagation was performed.
